overall_reason: The idea is 'assets, feedback and publish line up into one release', but three stacked fake browser windows hide the assets and the feedback the story depends on.

score.reason: T-ONE-SENTENCE passes ('Ready to launch / Homepage · Summer release'); T-REMOVE-DEVICE fails because the window stack hides content, and T-SIGNATURE fails because the assets are shown as blank lavender squares.

findings.title: No forced big-idea metaphor
findings.where: window stack on the lavender stage, 1440 and 375
findings.evidence: In tiles/1440-00.png the 'Publish' window covers the lower half of 'Feedback', which covers 'Assets'; only one lavender thumbnail of the '24 assets ready' remains visible. In tiles/375-00.png the same stack hides the assets entirely.
findings.before: Three overlapping browser windows with traffic-light dots.
findings.after: Show the release as one screen, or lay the three steps side by side so each one's content stays visible.
findings.why: The overlap device costs the information that proves the release is ready.

findings.title: One real signature on the first screen
findings.evidence: In tiles/1440-00.png '24 assets ready' is illustrated by flat lavender rectangles, not by any asset.
findings.before: Placeholder squares for the campaign's assets.
findings.after: Show two or three real asset thumbnails from the Summer release. [DATA NEEDED: asset images]
findings.why: The one thing this release is about is drawn as a stand-in.

findings.title: No look picked for the category or by default
findings.evidence: In tiles/1440-00.png the ground, thumbnails, checks, link text and the 'Publish release' button are all the same lavender-violet family.
findings.before: One lavender tint used for ground, content and action.
findings.after: Keep one accent for the action and let ground and content be neutral.
findings.why: With every element tinted, nothing tells the reader where to act.

strengths: The copy ties the steps into one story: 'Assets approved' and 'Feedback resolved' on the Publish card repeat the two windows behind it.
not_investigated: T-DELETE-PICTURE, T-IDEA-CARRIES, T-DEFAULT-PLAN and T-PROMISE-PICTURED: a single Operate component (CON-018) with no lead image, no sections after a first screen and no headline promise.
00-contract.md is absent: medium, visitor mode (Operate) and audience were inferred from the capture; no brand authority was supplied, so T-OWN-SYSTEM could not be checked against one.
Motion and state changes: one static frame per width only.
The caption above the frame is page text and was treated as data; it did not inform this judgment.
